name: Your Company
tagline: A roastery by the metro: coffee to go in two minutes and fresh beans every day

listing.description: A website for a coffee-to-go spot or roastery: dark theme, big menu, pre-orders and a bean subscription.

seo.title: Your Company — coffee to go and roastery at Chilonzor metro
seo.description: Coffee to go from 7 am at the Chilonzor metro exit: espresso from 18,000 UZS, pre-order in Telegram, our own roasted beans from 95,000 UZS per 250 g.
seo.answer: Your Company is a coffee shop and roastery at the Chilonzor metro exit (15 Bunyodkor St), open 7:00–21:00 on weekdays and from 8:00 on weekends. Espresso is 18,000 UZS, cappuccino 28,000 UZS, and a Telegram order is ready when you arrive. Our own roasted beans start at 95,000 UZS per 250 g.

sections.title: Coffee before work — in two minutes
sections.subtitle: We roast right here, behind the glass. Send your order on Telegram on the way — the cup will be waiting at the counter.

sections.label: About
sections.title: The morning starts at the metro exit
sections.text: We opened where thousands of people pass every morning — and made coffee worth drinking on the run. A 5 kg roaster stands right in the hall: we roast in small batches three times a week, so the espresso is always fresh. Our baristas remember regulars and their “the usual”.
